objective: Materialize deterministic client-retention cohort semantics for repeat_request_30d and repeat_completion_90d from canonical ORD analytics projections without identity stitching or rehire inference.

rootCause.missingMetric: ANA-A04 declares retention.repeat_request_30d but has no corresponding projection helper.
rootCause.segmentationGap: The existing repeatCompletionRate helper aggregates by client but does not carry immutable category/state cohort dimensions required by the ANA maturity-4 segmentation criterion.
rootCause.semanticGap: Repeat orders must not be interpreted as rehire, and cohort maturity must be evaluated against dataThrough rather than computedAt.

metrics.numerator: mature cohort clients with order.requested on a different order after first completion and within 30 days
mature cohort clients with order.completed on a different order after first completion and within 90 days

segmentation.cohortAnchor: immutable serviceCategory/serviceState on the first completed order
segmentation.rationale: The metric measures client retention of an acquisition/first-completion cohort. A later order in another category still represents retained marketplace demand.

invariants: Only canonical ORD client_id is used; anonymous or cross-device identity stitching is prohibited.
The cohort anchor is the first canonical order.completed event for the client.
The repeat event must belong to a different order from the first completion.
Cohort maturity is evaluated against dataThrough, never computedAt.
A repeat in another category or state still counts for the initial cohort segment.
Repeat order activity is retention evidence and does not imply REP-001 rehire.
Zero denominator returns null rather than zero.
Missing cohort dimensions yield partial coverage instead of fabricated segmentation.
activationRequirements: append-only metric snapshots through ANA-A04/A05 revision semantics
preservedBoundaries: ORD-001 remains canonical for order facts and client_id.
ANA owns only derived retention projections.
REP-001 remains authoritative for explicit rehire/reputation semantics.
LEGAL-B03 remains authoritative for privacy and identity lifecycle.
Browser analytics remains disabled by default.

maturity.reason: A08 closes repository retention semantics only. Runtime projection/staging evidence, funnel, CAT liquidity and A07 runtime freshness remain required for ANA maturity 4.
